lines.text: The angel says these words are faithful and true, and Jesus says He is coming soon.
John falls at the angel's feet to worship him, but the angel says to worship God.
Jesus is coming soon with His reward, and He is the Alpha and the Omega.
Those who wash their robes may eat from the tree of knowledge, and Jesus calls Himself the Root and Offspring of Saul.
Anyone who adds to the words of this book will receive its visions, and the grace of the Lord Jesus is with all the saints.
